name: Park Hyatt Johannesburg
positioning: Park Hyatt hotel set within a restored Sir Herbert Baker landmark in the heart of Johannesburg's Rosebank district
best_for: Travelers who want a Rosebank base close to the Gautrain station
Guests who value butler service and rooms with private patios

facts.text: The hotel is at 6 Tottenham Avenue in Johannesburg.
The hotel keeps original architectural details and has courtyard gardens.
The heated outdoor pool is set amid manicured gardens.
The Lounge offers artisanal cocktails and light bites.
Rooms have a private patio and lounge, plus a bathtub, an open-plan shower and dual granite-top vanities.
Parking is free, and valet parking is available.
The Gautrain station is 0.4 kilometers from the hotel.
Airport transfers are offered by Mercedes EQS or Mercedes V-Class.
The hotel earned a One Key distinction from the Michelin Travel Guide in 2025.
The hotel was recognized among Time Magazine's World's Greatest Places in 2026.

highlights.text: The hotel is set within a restored landmark by Sir Herbert Baker in the heart of Rosebank.
Room 32 is built around cooking over flame with locally sourced ingredients, celebrating South African flavors through a la carte selections and tasting menus.
The hotel offers a Personal Concierge and Butler Service.
The Wellness Suite has a private lounge, a hot tub and wellness-focused amenities.
The Terrace offers alfresco dining with views of Rosebank.

considerations.text: The spa is still being created; in the meantime, wellness treatments are offered in-room.
The meeting space is small, accommodating up to 16 guests.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack a traditional safari lodge atmosphere.
